name: B10-0164/2026 (PPE) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Georgia's government to release Elene Khoshtaria and everyone else held for political reasons. It says the charges against them are politically motivated and should be dropped. It wants Georgia to scrap its repressive laws and restore media freedom and civil liberties. It also asks European Union member states to impose targeted sanctions on the Georgian Dream regime and those who carry out political arrests, prosecutions and violence against opponents, protesters and journalists.

- Nothing changes yet: this is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- It targets Georgia's government, officials behind political arrests, and the people they detain.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union member states and Georgia's president, government and parliament.
